digest.component_or_area: S3 remote storage doctor / multi-bundle convergence
propositions: Multiple bundles for a single ref cause git clone to fail with 'multiple updates for ref not allowed' and push to stall indefinitely because git-remote-s3 rejects all writes while bundles>1 and ambiguous ref fetch cannot converge retries.

Upstream's git-remote-s3 Doctor.fix_multiple_bundles is unusable for autonomous fleets: it blocks on interactive input() prompts and by default discards the non-chosen head's events, losing unique ticket history from the append-only store.

S3 multi-bundle state is ordinary ref divergence hidden at the bundle-storage layer, solvable by lossless 2-parent merge (following rebar's existing sync._union_merge semantics) followed by atomic bundle collapse on the remote.

The heal must acquire the helper's per-ref lock, enumerate bundles under the lock (TOCTOU guard), fetch all heads, fold them via iterated 2-parent merges reusing sync's semantics, write the merged tip as a new bundle before deleting any original, and never delete the merged result.
On a genuine content conflict (non-derived file edited divergently) the heal must abort without deleting any bundle and surface fsck-recover rather than silently discarding a parent.

Concurrent doctors must not corrupt or duplicate repair: exactly one acquires the helper's per-ref lock and merges; the rest observe the lock held and back off, converging on the winner's collapsed remote on their next push retry.
